messages.subject: Your Porn Fetch license
messages.body:
Thank you for supporting the project on Patreon. Your signed license file {filename} is attached to this email.

Save the attachment and select it from the license activation screen in Porn Fetch. The file does not contain your email address and can be verified offline.

If you did not request a license, do not reply with sensitive data; contact the operator using the address shown in the legal notice.
